row: Welcome to my channel. I am a small animal veterinarian who is tired of owners being kept in the dark about their pet's health. I am here to change that - I believe every owner deserves to know all the facts about what is happening with their pets, and I am here to do just that, in simple language without the fluff and without the fancy terminology.
